description: Walk-forward optimized market-neutral blend of the five validated components (equity TSM pure, equity DN low-beta, futures TSM 18m, futures realized-roll-yield carry, macro momentum). Close-to-close convention, class-appropriate base costs, 504-day formation / 21-day rebalance / 63-day step.

pre_registered.beta_constraints: |beta vs SPY| <= 0.10 AND |beta vs equal-weight de-seamed futures index| <= 0.10
pre_registered.optimizer: Ledoit-Wolf (2004) shrinkage covariance (scaled-identity target), ridge lambda=1e-4, SLSQP with seeded Dirichlet(1) grid fallback (2000 samples)

falsification_expectations.FE1: pairwise |corr| <= 0.5 for >= 80% of the 10 component pairs (full-sample)
falsification_expectations.FE2: optimized in-sample Sharpe exceeds 1/N in-sample Sharpe by >= 0.2, averaged over formation windows

pre_registered.placebo: 50 sims; component weights re-drawn from Dirichlet(1) at each rebalance (component-level permutation null), same rebalance/execution/cost structure

sensitivity_grid.note: reported, not gated; no post-hoc selection

implementation_gaps: 5 components (not 'many assets'); 1/N is the natural null
components are validated strategies with embedded internal costs, not raw factors

convention_findings.finding: The dollar_neutral_longshort_weights construction (used as-is per the pre-registered component spec) is market-neutral under the OVERNIGHT convention (beta -0.035, the convention under which E012/E013 validated it) but carries a large POSITIVE equity beta under the v1.2.3 close-to-close convention (beta ~ +1.0). E024 audited the dn_lowbeta Sharpe under both conventions (c2c 1.053 / overnight 1.289) but did not re-measure its beta under c2c. This convention-dependence is a primary reason the blend cannot reach |beta vs SPY| <= 0.1 out-of-sample: the component believed to be a market-neutral diversifier is a high-beta equity sleeve under c2c.
convention_findings.dollar_neutral_longshort_weights_directi: As implemented, dollar_neutral_longshort_weights sizes the k largest rank-percentiles long and the k smallest short; under rank(ascending=False) the largest signal maps to the smallest percentile, so the book is long the smallest-signal (highest-beta) names and short the largest-signal (lowest-beta) names - the reverse of the docstring's 'long the top by signal' and of the low-beta strategy intent. Used as-is (pre-registered); recorded here because it determines the component's c2c beta sign.

placebo_caveat: The pre-registered placebo draws unconstrained Dirichlet(1) component weights (per the spec), so it can load on the high-Sharpe, high-beta TSM-pure component that the beta-constrained blend must hold down. A negative placebo z therefore measures the Sharpe cost of the market-neutrality constraint, not a lack of component edge; it is consistent with the FE2 falsification.

sensitivity_market_neutral_summary.multiple_testing_note: 8 of 96 pre-registered sensitivity configs achieve |beta vs SPY| <= 0.1 with OOS Sharpe >= 0.8. These are EXPLORATORY (the grid is reported, not gated); selecting any of them for promotion would be post-hoc multiple-testing and requires a dedicated pre-registered confirmatory run with a full placebo test (G2) before any promotion.
